note: camera-sweep-apexprof-1117: docs/280 camera sweep for camera-stutter profiling (agent camera_sweep, report camera-sweep-report.ts via profile-world.ts). Measurement + correctness, not a timing A/B: one arm, Apex default. Bin state apex (the chain sets it: node tools/turbo-compat.ts state <snapshot dir> apex; restore after). Install build/ts3agent.package = ts3agent.package.camera-sweep-1117 (docs/data/builds.json) before the run. Household untouched: N/A, the command moves only the camera (no Sim, lot or save change). Needs a quiet machine only for the absolute numbers; the per-segment split is the point. apexProfiler: true sets ApexRadiance.toml [ui] developer_mode, [qol.frame_profiler] start_at_load + write_file for the job (put back after it). Needs a DEVELOPER Apex build in Bin (the public release compiles the profiler out, APEX_NO_DEV_TOOLS): the job log says "Apex frame profiler did NOT start" otherwise. Output next to the frames csv: <tag>-ApexRadiance_FrameTimeline.csv (split per segment by tick_ms: room_solve_calls, Lot room solve ms, hitches led by it), <job>-ApexRadiance_Hitches.txt. For Apex's author on his dev build, or for us once he sends one. node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/camera-sweep-apexprof-1117.json
